candidate.user_submission: Child is 18 months old. Has fever for 2 days, temperature 38.0C. No generalized rash. No obvious cause of fever present. No identified bacterial cause was identified in this assessment. Malaria test available, result negative. No cough with measles. No measles within last 3 months. No red eyes. No runny nose. No stiff neck. Has cough or difficult breathing, cough for 3 days. Breaths counted for one full minute. Child was calm during assessment. No chest indrawing. No stridor when calm. No wheezing. No recurrent wheeze. Pulse oximeter not available. Not convulsing now. No history of convulsions. Not lethargic or unconscious. Able to drink or breastfeed. No diarrhoea.
